nav.label: Main
search.title: Find the right researcher at UiS
search.lede: Describe what you are looking for in your own words. We rank {n} researchers from the {f} faculties of the University of Stavanger by how well their published work matches.
search.label: Describe what you are looking for
search.placeholder: e.g. machine learning for offshore wind maintenance
search.keywordOnly: Preview: matching currently uses words in titles and keywords. Meaning-based search (also in Norwegian) is added in the next step.
search.syntax: Tip: put words in quotes for the exact phrase ("computer science education"), and combine with AND or OR in capitals: "wind energy" AND maintenance OR offshore.
search.none: No researchers match these words. Try broader or different terms.
search.affinity: Match strength relative to the best result
r.summaryPending: Overview not generated yet – shown here once AI summaries are produced (next milestone).
ov.ledeAllStaff: Research activity based on Scopus publications since {from}. Included: everyone in the UiS employee directory with a Scopus profile, and others with at least {umin} publications since {usince}.
ov.lede: Research activity based on Scopus publications since {from}. Included: staff in the UiS employee directory with at least {min} publication since {since}, and others with at least {umin} publications since {usince}.
ov.perYearSub: {y} is still in progress and shown lighter. {units} share one scale so they can be compared.
ov.collabSub: Number of papers co-authored by researchers from both units. Stronger colour means more joint papers.
ov.themesSub: Most frequent author keywords per department. Click a theme to find researchers working on it.
net.title: Who works with whom
net.lede: {n} researchers connected by {e} co-authorships. Each dot is a researcher (size = publications), each line a shared paper. Researchers are grouped around their faculty, or their department when one faculty is selected.
net.isolated: Also show researchers without UiS co-authors
net.aria: Co-authorship network of researchers, coloured by department. The table below lists the most connected researchers.
net.help: Click a researcher to see their profile and collaborators; click a collaborator to move on. Double-click opens the full profile. Esc or a click on the background returns to the whole network. Drag to move; use the mouse wheel (or + and −) to zoom in on the point under the cursor.
net.mostConnectedSub: Ranked by number of different UiS co-authors in the network.
net.name: Name
p.noCoauthors: No co-authors among the researchers in this atlas.
p.collabDeptsSub: Papers with co-authors from other departments.
footer.prototypeText: Test version under development. Data use and researcher profiles are awaiting confirmation from the UiS Library and data protection officer.
footer.source: Source: Scopus (Elsevier), publications since {from}, retrieved {date}. Departments and positions: UiS employee directory.
footer.summaries: Researcher overviews are generated automatically from publications and describe research only. Researchers can request corrections or opt out.
footer.designerRole: Professor in Biomedical Sensing Systems, University of Stavanger.
net.noCollaborators: No co-authors among the researchers in this atlas.

ov.titleScope: Selected faculties and departments at a glance
ov.byUnitSub: Researchers and publications per unit. Click a name to browse its researchers.
net.byFaculty: Several faculties selected: researchers are grouped and coloured by faculty. Select one faculty to see its departments.

sl.title: Shortlist
sl.lede: Researchers you have shortlisted, side by side – for example for a proposal team. The list is kept in this browser only; share it as a link.
sl.empty: Your shortlist is empty. Use “+ Shortlist” on search results to add researchers.
sl.shared: You are viewing a shared shortlist (researchers: {n}).
ex.title: Explore the faculties
f.lockedText: This part of the atlas is for UiS research staff and research advisers. Enter the password you received.
f.missing: Funding data has not been published yet.
f.unsupported: Your browser cannot open the protected funding pages. Please use a current version of Edge, Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
f.error: The funding data could not be loaded.
f.title: Funding calls
f.lede: Calls from the Research Council of Norway and EU funding topics (Horizon Europe, ERC, MSCA, EIC and other EU programmes), matched with the published work of UiS researchers from the last {years} years. Matches are suggestions based on publications; they are not an assessment of chances of funding.
f.search: Search call titles or a researcher
f.withMatches: Only calls with matching UiS researchers
f.matchesNone: No UiS researcher with clearly matching recent work
f.uisApplicant: UiS can apply as project owner
f.reviewText: Something in this call could not be read unambiguously. Check the official page.
f.freshness: Calls synchronised {sync} · matched {matched} · researcher data {people} · method {algo}
f.stale: {src}: this information may be out of date (last successful synchronisation {date}).
f.syncErrors: {src}: the last synchronisation had {n} errors; the last verified information is shown.
f.showUnspecified: Also show what the call does not specify ({n})
f.fallback: Only available in the other language
f.docsNote: Downloadable call PDFs are not collected (RCN's robots.txt); open them from the official page.
f.extracted: Extracted {date} from the official pages. Facts are shown with their source; nothing is filled in by guesswork.
f.noChanges: No changes recorded since the call was first collected.
f.aiProfileNote: Generated by AI from the official call text. Items marked "From the call" are backed by a quote that was checked against the call; interpretations are suggestions.
f.noProfile: An AI reading of the scientific scope has not been made for this call yet. Matching uses the official text below.
f.specialistFor: Among the best at UiS for
f.aspectsSub: The parts of the call used for matching. Each researcher is checked against each of them.
f.matchLede: Ranked by how well their publications since {y} fit this call. High, Medium and Low compare researchers for this call only. Eligibility is checked separately from the call text.
f.noMatches: No UiS researcher has recent publications that clearly match this call. This can mean the call is administrative, open to all fields, or outside current UiS research – or that its text is too short to match on.
f.closedNoMatch: Matching is only done for open and planned calls.
f.scoreHelp: Scope: how closely the best recent papers fit the call. Coverage: share of the call's aspects covered by a paper. Evidence: amount of relevant recent work. Not a probability of funding.
f.missingAspects: Not covered by their recent papers
f.role.rd_partner: R&D partner to an applicant company or organisation
f.elig.likely_ineligible: Probably not eligible as project manager
f.reason.none_found: The call text names no requirement that rules this person out. Always check the official requirements.
f.reason.uis_not_applicant: The call is not open to research organisations as applicants.
f.reason.early_career_senior: The call limits the years since the doctorate (early career), and the person holds a professor position.
f.reason.early_career_long_record: The call limits the years since the doctorate, and the person has published for more than 12 years – check the PhD date.
f.reason.senior_call_junior: The call requires several years since the doctorate (experienced researchers), and the person is a PhD candidate or postdoc.
f.reason.doctorate_required: The call requires a doctorate, and the person is a PhD candidate.
f.reason.position_emeritus: Emeritus position: employment requirements may not be met.
f.reason.position_external: Externally affiliated: employment requirements may not be met.
f.reason.position_adjunct: Adjunct (II) position: check the requirements for the project manager's employment.
f.collabNote: Suggestions based on publications – nobody has agreed to take part.
f.coverageSub: For each aspect of the call: researchers among the matches whose recent papers cover it. Aspects nobody covers point to partners to look for outside the group.
f.coverageNobody: Not covered by any matched researcher
f.profileSub: Open and planned calls from the Research Council of Norway that fit {name}'s publications since {y}.
f.profileNone: No open or planned call currently matches this researcher's recent publications clearly.
f.profileLocked: Matching funding calls are shown here for users with the funding password.
fld.title: Official title
fld.funding_rate: Scope of support and funding rate
fld.uis_can_apply: UiS can be project owner / coordinator
fld.documents: Documents and links in the call
f.openField: This call is open to all research fields, so researchers are not matched on topic. Any UiS researcher who meets the requirements can apply. The call says:
f.searchPlaceholder: e.g. quantum, or a researcher's name
f.forResearcher: Calls for {name}: topic matches from their recent publications, and calls open to all fields with their eligibility.
f.openFieldSub: These calls accept applications from every field, so they are shown to everyone. Eligibility is estimated from job title and the first UiS publication (the atlas has no PhD dates) – always check the requirements.
f.openFieldCounts: {a} UiS researchers in the atlas have no restriction found, {b} should check the requirements, and {c} are probably not eligible as project manager.
f.openFieldHow: Search for a researcher above the call list, or open a profile, to see one person's eligibility.
f.reason.thesis_submitted: The call accepts a submitted (not yet defended) thesis – PhD candidates should check whether this applies.
f.openFallback: No call title or researcher matches “{q}”. Showing the calls open to all research fields, which anyone eligible can apply to.
f.openFallbackPick: Showing the calls open to all research fields until you choose a researcher.
f.norwayCheck: Check: the topic limits participation to some countries
f.officialEu: Topic on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal
f.docsNoteEu: Documents are linked from the EU Funding & Tenders Portal, not copied. Work programme annexes (e.g. eligible countries, standard evaluation criteria) apply in addition to the topic text.
f.amountNote: EU amounts are in euro; for this filter they are compared at about 11.5 NOK per euro.
f.reason.eu_company_only: Company funding (e.g. EIC Accelerator): UiS cannot apply; a UiS spin-off or start-up may.
f.reason.eu_restricted: The topic limits participation to some countries – check whether Norwegian organisations are included.
f.reason.eu_country_unknown: Norway's participation in this EU programme has not been determined – check the programme's eligible countries.
f.role.supervisor: Supervisor / host for the fellow or doctoral candidates
f.institutionLevel: The institution applies for this call as a whole, so it is not matched to individual researchers. Contact the research office if UiS should take part.
f.reason.erc_doctorate: ERC principal investigators must hold a doctorate, and the person is a PhD candidate.
f.reason.erc_stg_window: ERC Starting Grant: 2–7 years since the PhD. The person holds a senior position or has published for more than 12 years – check the PhD date.
f.reason.erc_cog_window: ERC Consolidator Grant: 7–12 years since the PhD. The person has published at UiS for more than 16 years – check the PhD date.
f.reason.erc_adg_record: ERC Advanced Grant: requires a track record of significant achievements over the last 10 years, and the person is a postdoc – check the requirements.
f.reason.msca_supervisor: UiS staff take part as supervisors, and the person is a PhD candidate.
f.reason.msca_supervisor_postdoc: UiS staff take part as supervisors – check whether a postdoc can supervise here.
